title: Poly[bis(μ 3 -3-amino-1,2,4-triazolato)
one_line_summary: Design rule: choose glutaric acid and 3-amino-1,2,4-triazole as bridging ligands

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] choose glutaric acid and 3-amino-1,2,4-triazole as bridging ligands → supports construction of the targeted extended coordination framework

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] use high-symmetry ligands → may yield novel structures

key_insights.title: Author Claim
key_insights.body: The framework contains two distinct Zn sites: one four-coordinated and one five-coordinated by triazolate N and glutarate O donors.

key_insights.title: Author Claim
key_insights.body: Binuclear Zn units are linked by glutarate and 3-amino-1,2,4-triazolate ligands to build the extended 3D polymer.

notable_quotes: The framework contains two distinct Zn sites: one four-coordinated and one five-coordinated by triazolate N and glutarate O donors.
Binuclear Zn units are linked by glutarate and 3-amino-1,2,4-triazolate ligands to build the extended 3D polymer.
Ligand design is presented as crucial for constructing specific inorganic coordination polymeric complexes.
